hypotheses.reasoning: At 06:00:31 catalog-db reports transaction 88973 from catalog-svc-reconciler sitting idle in transaction while holding RowExclusiveLock on products. After that, catalog-svc UPDATEs on products wait for a ShareLock on that transaction (#140, #150) and get canceled at the 10s statement timeout (#146, #152, #170). Because of that, search-api's CatalogClient.getBatch calls time out at 15s (#147, #153, #171). search-api's 50-connection pool to catalog-svc then fills up and checkouts time out (#169, #176, #183), and web-bff returns 504s on GET /search starting at 06:04. These are symptoms. The translation API connection reset at 05:55 recovered on retry and is unrelated. No deploy appears in the logs.
search-api's pool to catalog-svc is saturated. But it fills only after the lock waits begin, so it is a symptom, not the cause.
The translation API reset its connection once, but the retry succeeded right away and this was 5 minutes before the incident started.

verdict.recommendedAction: Terminate the catalog-svc-reconciler backend that is idle in transaction (txn 88973), for example with pg_terminate_backend, so the lock on products is released. Then fix the reconciler so it commits promptly and closes its transactions on every code path. Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout on catalog-db. Watch search-api's pool to catalog-svc and the web-bff 504 rate until they recover.
